source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 208 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-208.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 208 was established by Ordinance No. 18826, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 7, 1985. Ordinance No. 18826 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18826; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-208.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 208 is established on property generally fronting on the east line of Scammel Drive, north of the north line of Blossom Lane. The size of PD 208 is approximately 9.719 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18826; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-208.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-208.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Utilization of the Property must be in conformance with the city plan commission-approved development plan (Exhibit 208A). (Ord. Nos. 18826; 25711)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-208.105. USES.

The only permitted use on the Property is single-family residential. (Ord. Nos. 18826; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Number Of Dwelling Units
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-208.106. MAXIMUM NUMBER OF DWELLING UNITS.

Maximum number of dwelling units permitted on the Property is 49. (Ord. Nos. 18826; 25711)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-208.107. SCREENING.

A solid wood screening fence that has a minimum height of six feet must be constructed along the north line of the lots fronting on the north line of Bearden Drive, and the west line of Lots 15, 16, and 17 fronting on the west line of Bearden Drive, as shown on the development plan. The fence must be constructed prior to the final inspection of any structure on the Property by the building official. (Ord. Nos. 18826; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-208.108. HEIGHT.

Maximum permitted height for any structure is 24 feet. An additional 12 feet of height is permitted for chimneys and architectural features. (Ord. Nos. 18826; 25711)

sections.title: Streets
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-208.109. STREETS.

All streets within the boundaries of the Property must be dedicated to the public. All streets within the boundaries of the Property must have 50 feet of dedicated right-of-way, and a minimum pavement width of 37 feet. All driveways, entrances, and dedicated streets must be constructed in accordance with all applicable codes, ordinances, regulations, and requirements of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18826; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-208.110. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Development of the Property must comply with the regulations applicable to an R-5 Single-Family Residential District, except where modified by these conditions. The development must also comply with all other applicable rules and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18826; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-208.111. ZONING MAP.

PD 208 is located on Zoning Map No. K-10. (Ord. Nos. 18826; 25711)
